events.continuity_hook: Moves the late-October upper Midwest loop from comparison into reservations.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the flight pair, rental-car pickup and return times, Milwaukee hotel placement, room details, window-seat requests, parking costs, breakfast windows, dinner backups, cancellation dates, and receipt notes.
events.scenario_brief: The upper Midwest loop is ready for reservations. The workable plan is Sunday afternoon travel from Salt Lake City to the Chicago area, a rental car kept through Wisconsin, and a Friday return from Milwaukee if the morning airport buffer stays reasonable. Holds expire tonight for an Oak Brook-area room Sunday and Monday, a Madison room Tuesday, and a west-side Milwaukee room Wednesday and Thursday; the main unresolved point is whether to keep both Milwaukee nights west-side or move Thursday to an airport-area hotel before the midday return.

events.continuity_hook: Handles the final timing details for the booked upper Midwest counselor loop.
events.interaction_goal: Set the Monday-through-Friday departure timeline, confirm checkout and luggage handling, pick breakfast backups for Madison and Milwaukee, plan dinner after the late events, and protect the Friday fuel, car-return, and bag-drop window.
events.scenario_brief: Six days before departure, the Madison breakfast host moves check-in to 7:05 a.m., the Wauwatosa venue sends a campus parking map with a nearby lot closed for construction, and the Milwaukee return flight shifts 18 minutes earlier. Flights, car, and rooms are booked, including the west-side Milwaukee stay, so the trip now needs practical timing rather than new searches.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a shorter regional work trip after the upper Midwest recruitment loop is complete.
events.interaction_goal: Compare driving with flying into Boise and renting a car, outline the road timing, shortlist Boise and Twin Falls hotel areas, flag breakfast and dinner logistics, and identify any reservations or holds that should be made before weather and rates shift.
events.scenario_brief: After returning from Wisconsin, Tessa is asked to cover a short mid-November Idaho counselor add-on: Monday afternoon travel, a Tuesday 7:30 a.m. counselor breakfast in Boise, a Tuesday evening fair in Nampa, a Wednesday morning high-school visit in Twin Falls, and a return to Salt Lake City that night. The trip is close enough to drive, but early winter weather could make the I-84 plan less predictable, so the unresolved pieces are drive versus fly-and-rent, Boise versus Twin Falls overnight placement, and simple meal access around the late fair.

events.continuity_hook: Refines the Idaho add-on after event times and weather risk become clearer.
events.interaction_goal: Choose the travel mode, decide whether Tuesday night belongs in Boise, Nampa, or Twin Falls, book the practical hotel setup, set safe drive windows, and prepare food and fuel stops that do not crowd the Wednesday morning visit.
events.scenario_brief: The Idaho hosts send updates before Tessa books: the Boise breakfast check-in moves to 7:00 a.m., the Nampa fair now ends at 8:35 p.m., and the Twin Falls school asks for an 8:15 a.m. arrival Wednesday. The forecast shows possible snow along part of the route, while the flight option has a workable Boise arrival but would add rental-car paperwork and less flexibility for the return drive home.

events.continuity_hook: Begins a personal family trip after the final fall work travel settles.
events.interaction_goal: Compare flight and driving logistics for three travelers, shortlist hotels near the venue with practical breakfast and dinner access, note parking or resort fees, and identify which refundable rooms are worth holding until the game schedule is firm.
events.scenario_brief: With fall recruitment winding down, Tessa starts planning an early-December family weekend in Las Vegas for one teenager's tournament. The first draft has a Friday evening team check-in, Saturday pool play, and a possible Sunday afternoon championship window. She and her spouse are weighing a Friday afternoon flight against driving from Salt Lake City, and hotel availability near the sports complex is uneven because of a busy event weekend.

events.continuity_hook: Updates the Las Vegas family weekend once the tournament times are available.
events.interaction_goal: Decide whether to drive instead of fly, choose the hotel hold, confirm the room setup for the family, plan breakfast before the early match, check late-checkout options, and set the cancellation and payment reminders.
events.scenario_brief: The tournament schedule posts: the first Saturday match is at 7:45 a.m., Friday check-in can be handled by the team manager, and Sunday games may run until 3:30 p.m. Airfare has risen since the first search, while driving would make the Sunday return less stressful. Two hotel holds expire the next day, one closer to the venue and one with better nearby restaurants but a longer morning drive.
